This document outlines the testing procedures P1, which must performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

This document outlines the inspection 
checklist for electrical safety valve. There is one valve per unit. The major 
parts of the valve are (coil and a pressure switch). It is installed on the line 
of the main steam. The main target of it is to protect the main steam line from 
high pressure.

The switch will be closed and will 
supply the125 dc volt to the coil at a pressure of 144 kg/cm2 and the safety 
valve will be opened to decrease the high pressure. When the pressure decreases 
to 137 kg/cm2 the switch will be opened and disconnect the 125 dc volt to the 
coil, then the safety valve will be closed.

The first 
draft initiated by eng. Hazem Mohamed Gamal at 17 April 2005, submitted 
by eng. Ibrahim Hefny at 24 April 2005, reviewed by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by General Director eng. Hamdy Azab, and 
approved by eng. Fawzy Sobhy Ismael: head sector of Abu Sultan Power Plant.

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general 
 director and MPIS Coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 admin. & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

This document outlines the inspection 
checklist for electrical safety valve. There is one valve per unit. The major 
parts of the valve are (coil and a pressure switch). It is installed on the line 
of the main steam. The main target of it is to protect the main steam line from 
high pressure.
The switch will be closed and will 
supply the125 dc volt to the coil at a pressure of 144 kg/cm2 and the safety 
valve will be opened to decrease the high pressure. When the pressure decreases 
to 137 kg/cm2 the switch will be opened and disconnect the 125 dc volt to the

Work to be Carried Out
Steps to Prepare for 
Test
Review Technical reference material and 
 manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of (The Coil and the Pressure 
 Switch) field maintenance File.
Remove 
 Coil and pressure switch Terminals by disconnecting wires (In the Terminal 
 Cabinet).
Testing Procedure (Coil)
Connect coil terminal to 125 DC voltage 
 external power supply.
Turn on the power supply switch.
The movement of the valve must be in the open 
 direction.
If no movement happened, check the coil-using 
 multimeter and measure the resistance of the coil after disconnecting the 
 terminals. If it's damaged, it has to be replaced with a new one.
Testing Procedure (Pressure Switch)
Connect the multimeter to the terminals of the 
 switch and measure the resistance. It has to be open.
Inject a pressure using the hydraulic pump 
 equals to the flowing calibration table
Open | 137 kg/cm2
Close | 144 kg/cm2
Calibrate the switch to 
 act like the status in the table.
Return Coil and Pressure Switch to Service
Return coil to service by disconnecting it from 
 the 125 DC voltage power supply
Reconnect the wires to the cabinet termination.
Return pressure switch to service by reconnect 
 the wires to the cabinet termination.
Connect main power.
Open manual isolating valve.
Place a copy of test result in the field 
 maintenance file.
Repeat all the previous steps for all other 
 units.
